### PiliBabel v2.6.6

**The quality pickers now point you at the tier you probably want**

**New: a recommended tier, highlighted, in the download quality pickers**

- The video / audio quality pickers offer many tiers, and most of them never show up in the official app's interface — easy to get lost.
- The picker now reads your *Settings → Audio & video* defaults (separate values for Wi-Fi and cellular), checks whether you are currently on Wi-Fi or cellular, and highlights the matching tier in **blue with a check mark**, plus a one-line note explaining what the highlight means.
- It is a hint, not a pre-selection: nothing is picked for you, the choice stays yours.
- If your configured tier isn't offered in the current list (e.g. you defaulted to 4K but 4K isn't available), the nearest tier below it is highlighted instead.
- All new strings go through the AI translation layer, as always.

Everything inherited from PiliNara / PiliPlus is unchanged.
